summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the required scope of a presentation regarding location model data. Initially, there was confusion about whether historical data analysis (past) was needed, given that the model was trained on Q4 2020 data. It was clarified that the focus should be exclusively on future technology predictions and development trends, specifically looking 3-5 years ahead.

The presentation should cover various technologies, including stable ones like Wifi and randomized MACs, as well as emerging technologies such as Lidar.
decisions: The presentation must focus only on future technology predictions, not historical data analysis.
action_items: Discuss the prediction content (3-5 years ahead) in a follow-up meeting.
